description: This file contains functions and constants related to processing and delivering replies in a Matrix chat environment, including filtering reasoning-only replies and handling message chunking and media attachments.

methods.name: shouldSuppressReasoningReplyText
methods.description: Determines whether a reply text should be suppressed based on reasoning tags or specific prefixes.

methods.name: deliverMatrixReplies
methods.description: Asynchronously processes and sends reply messages to a Matrix room, handling media, chunking, and reply modes.
